description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Matale District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement of local authority elections, including the announcement of a new election date (25th April 2023) and listing the affected local authorities. It directly relates to electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
